hook.text: 澳洲要设AI安全监管机构

summary.sub: 监管、收费、开源各一条，均用一手原文加独立媒体核对。

items.t: Albanese宣布设AI安全监管机构，AI安全事件须强制报告，起因是OpenAI agent访问Medicare统计网站
Apple推出一次性购买的AI用量包，目前只能在Logic Pro里买，12个月后过期
美团以MIT许可证开源LongCat-2.5，1.6万亿总参数的多模态MoE模型，主打agent编程

mp.title: 澳洲要设AI安全监管机构，Apple开卖AI用量包，美团开源LongCat-2.5

title.text: 澳洲宣布设立AI安全监管机构

oneline.text: AI公司违规可被重罚，安全事件须强制报告，模型要接受独立评估。

bullets.v: 11月10日Albanese宣布，政府将提议设立专门的AI安全监管机构，可对违规AI公司处以重罚。
起因是OpenAI的技术6月访问了Medicare统计网站，公司直到9月才通知联邦政府。
罚款金额、适用门槛和立法时间都还没公布，官方只说细节将适时发布。

sourceEvidence.quote: The Government will propose these protections be enforced by a new targeted regulator for AI safety
The regulator would be able to enforce significant penalties for AI companies that fail to comply
Further details of the legislation will become available in due course
The US-based OpenAI's technology accessed a Medicare statistics website in June
the firm did not inform federal authorities about the incident until September.
Albanese said the government would accept all 18 recommendations from a rapid review into the OpenAI breach.

oneline.text: Creator Studio月度AI额度用完后，可以花钱买额外用量。

bullets.v: Apple推出一次性购买的AI用量包，9to5Mac报道售价49.99美元，目前只有Logic Pro能买。
Apple Intelligence第一次出现按用量付费，未用完的额度逐月滚存，12个月后过期。
Apple没写一个包到底含多少额外用量，支持文档里也没写价格。

sourceEvidence.claim: 一次性购买、不支持家人共享
sourceEvidence.quote: Intelligence usage packs are available as a one-time purchase. They don't support Family Sharing and can be used only by the Apple Account you were using for iCloud

sourceEvidence.claim: 超出月度额度后才消耗
sourceEvidence.quote: Additional usage gets consumed for relevant features only after you've reached your monthly limit in any given month.
The only option is a $49.99 one-time purchase of an 'intelligence usage pack.'
Right now the only app that lets you buy additional AI usage is Logic Pro

oneline.text: 1.6万亿总参数的多模态MoE模型，把视觉理解和agent编程放进一个模型。

bullets.v: 11月9日美团在Hugging Face发布LongCat-2.5权重，距模型首次亮相一周。
MIT许可证可商用、可改，专家权重和激活做了W4A4量化，原生支持INT4计算。
跑分来自官方数据，限时API价格何时结束未说明。

sourceEvidence.quote: LongCat-2.5 is a native multimodal MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks, with 1.6 trillion total parameters
LongCat-2.5 applies W4A4 quantization to expert weights and activations, enabling native INT4 computation
Meituan released the weights for LongCat-2.5 on Nov. 9, one week after introducing the model.
The Chinese food delivery and e-commerce company published the checkpoint on Hugging Face under the MIT License
lists a limited-time rate of $0.006 per million cached input tokens alongside $0.30 for uncached input
